title: Android Wear IOB not available
symptom: The user is using xDrip on their phone and Android Wear device, and cannot find a way to display their current IOB (Insulin on Board) on the watchface, although other values like estimated A1c are available as toast messages.
evidence_quote: I now have informations about my estimated A1c etc as a toast message, but I haven't found a way to get my current IoB!
